title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Work IQ API access to declarative agents
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, consent and enablement requirements, consumption licensing, and documented MCP safeguards are supported. Minor corrections should extend the spending-policy navigation, name the update API's deciding properties, and reconcile the governance checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: Applications can programmatically access first-party and tenant-defined declarative agents through the Work IQ endpoint for specialised workflow tasks.
claims.quote: Enables programmatic access to first‑party and tenant‑defined declarative agents via the Work IQ endpoint, allowing applications to trigger specialized agents for domain‑specific tasks within broader workflows.
